text: New Era Cap, LLC is a Buffalo-based headwear company described as family-owned, led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch. Private-equity firm ACON Investments calls New Era a portfolio company: it invested in January 2021 as New Era's first institutional equity capital, closed a roughly $700 million continuation fund in August 2022 that made Major League Baseball, the National Football League and the National Basketball Association minority owners, and said in June 2024 it would maintain a significant stake in the combined company acquiring '47.
short: New Era Cap is family-owned (Koch family) with a significant ACON Investments stake; MLB, the NFL and the NBA took minority stakes in 2022.
